configure_sharding_strategy: configure FSDP sharding strategy to shard parameters gradients and optimizer states across ranks
setup_backward_prefetch: setup backward prefetching to overlap all-gather with gradient computation and improve throughput
configure_mixed_precision: configure FSDP mixed precision training with configurable parameter reduce and buffer dtypes
save_full_state_dict: save a full unsharded state dict using rank0_only offload to cpu and full state dict config
save_sharded_optim_state: save sharded optimizer state dict as DTensor with CPU offload for distributed checkpointing
